title: The NBA doesn't just want to build a European basketball league — it wants to revolutionize the international pro game
raw_text:
Key Points
- Nonbinding bids for permanent teams in the NBA Europe league are due next month.
- The NBA has spoken with Amazon Prime Video and YouTube, among other media companies, to potentially broadcast NBA Europe games globally.
- The NBA is targeting London, Paris, Rome, Madrid, Barcelona, Athens, Istanbul and Berlin as permanent homes for teams.
- The NBA wants to partner or merging with EuroLeague, according to people familiar with the matter.
